description: This file defines an interface for managing JSON-based storage operations, including reading, writing, and deleting data, within a storage provider framework. It is part of the Samples.StorageProviders namespace and is intended for lower-level storage management in a grain-based system.

classes.name: IJSONStateDataManager
classes.description: An interface that specifies methods for deleting, reading, and writing JSON data in a storage provider context, supporting asynchronous operations and disposal.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the grain state associated with a specified key from a collection asynchronously.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads the grain state from storage and returns a JSON string if it exists, or null otherwise, asynchronously.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes a JSON string representing grain state to storage for a specified key asynchronously.
